<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to an SN2 substitution where a halide (e.g., Cl) is displaced by a nucleophile forming a C‑N bond. Using the template catalog search we can look for templates that break a “halide” functional group and form a “C-N” (amine) bond. Once we have the template ID, we will apply it to the target molecule to obtain all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
